Closure.doc: The machine's output: how the ticket ended.

SupportTicket.doc:
A support ticket from the moment it arrives until it is closed.
Every top-level final state is one way a ticket can end.

Assign.doc: An agent claims the ticket by hand.

FollowUpIn.doc: The agent asks to be reminded of the ticket after a while, whatever happens to it meanwhile.

FollowUp.doc: The reminder the agent asked for. Only the ticket raises it.

root.name: SupportTicket
root.doc:
A support ticket from the moment it arrives until it is closed.
Every top-level final state is one way a ticket can end.

states.name: Intake
states.doc: Classify the new ticket and screen out spam and duplicates.

states.name: ClassifyBackoff
states.doc: Retry loop: the classifier is down, wait and try again.

states.name: Unclassified
states.doc: The classifier stayed down: carry on with normal priority and no category.

states.name: Triage
states.doc: Find an owner. Unowned past the triage SLA pages the on-call lead.

states.name: Queued
states.doc: Nobody is free: try again every 15 minutes.

states.name: Active
states.doc: The ticket has an owner and is being worked.

states.name: WithAgent
states.doc: The agent owns the next move. Nudge them after every 2 hours of silence.

states.name: WaitingOnCustomer
states.doc: The ball is in the customer's court. Two weeks of silence closes the ticket.

states.name: OnHold
states.doc: Parked by the agent, for example while waiting on a third party.

states.name: Escalation
states.doc: Escalation tiers. Each tier has a deadline before it moves up.

states.name: Engineering
states.doc: Engineering owns it: file a bug and wait for the fix.

states.name: Resolving
states.doc: Two things at once: check the fix holds, and draft the message to the customer.

states.name: AwaitingConfirmation
states.doc: Resolved on our side. The customer confirms, reopens or goes quiet.

states.name: Reopened
states.doc: Reopen loop: back to the agent, or straight to escalation from the third reopen.

states.name: Closing
states.doc: Ask the customer how we did, then close.

SatisfactionSurvey.doc: Send a satisfaction survey and wait up to a week for the answer.

root.name: SatisfactionSurvey
root.doc: Send a satisfaction survey and wait up to a week for the answer.

states.name: Waiting
states.doc: Check for an answer once a day.
